motivation: The prior physical test exposed small-canvas inference failure. Padding-normalization is known prior art(#1481,#1483,#1646,#1773). Development shows normalization repair alone does not reliably recover full-context ink. Preserve actual parent CT context and global patch identities instead.
target_change: New modular ink ROI preparation/inference tool. It does not convert the old GrowPatch grid bound into an anatomical or general ink superiority claim.
candidate: faithful_roi.plan_roi + infer_roi: all parent-global128x128 tiles intersecting the requested80x80 rectangle, stride64, stock floored-Hann weights, fixed reader and checkpoint; preserve all contributing tile identities/normalization context; crop only the final accumulator.
primary_comparisons: Current Main normalize-all-zero-padded local80x80 input,128 model patch
Existing PR1483/1773 training-consistent normalization on observed80x80, with normalized padding0
Full-frame masked inference on the parent grid; strong quality-equivalence baseline, not a claimed accuracy improvement over it

reader.scope: PHerc0139 trained; PHerc0841 absent from embedded training datasets and data provenance. Source label transfer for0841 has annotated_on unknown; report that limit.

selection.rule: Use only reference arrays and source metadata: grid centres64,192,...(stride128) in model-resolution canvas; rank candidates by SHA256(sample|segment|centre|seed20261020); require >=90% supervised pixels and >=128 positive and128 negative in central64x64. Choose requested count with disjoint contributing source CT chunk sets from older acquisitions and from earlier chosen cases. No score/CT-intensity selection. If insufficient, retain unavailable count.
selection.inputs: 80x80 at centre, scored64x64 centre(+8); no post-hoc label XY/normal/depth search or replacement after CT/model outputs.
selection.reference0139: Use native full-resolution public annotation/supervision arrays from the prior experiment, but fresh CT contexts; label exposure is explicit.
selection.reference0841: Resolve coarse label metadata/preview to shortlist, then decode exact full-resolution label and supervision crops. At each model-grid pixel pool4x4 label pixels: require all16 supervised; positive if ink fraction>=.75, negative only if fraction==0, ambiguous pixels abstain. Not a new3D registration reference.
selection.CT0841: Published2.403um surface-volume XY level2(4x block means), mean-pool Z in nonoverlapping4-plane blocks from0, discard incomplete trailing block. Select central17 of floor(Z/4), rounded uint8. Model sampling9.612um; no fitted transfer.

freshness: No required CT object in any older workspace acquisition ledger or chosen prior physical published-surface CT receipts. This is recorded local exposure, not a universal globally-unused claim.

metrics.primary: Tie-correct AUC on identical qualified reference support; all cases and exclusions retained
metrics.fidelity: Compare crop tool with independently enumerated current Main parent-global masked schedule and full-frame accumulation on the same tile probabilities. Max float32 difference<=1e-6 and encoded uint8 ROI exact. Also check nesting80->96->80 exact.
metrics.cost: Report actual fetched bytes, inferred tiles, accumulator/output bytes. Full-parent tile-count savings are analytic unless actually run. Existing mask baseline can already save model tiles; claim only additional ROI-sized output/accumulator and avoiding mask-image requirement against it.
metrics.controls: Frozen half-width cyclic labels and transpose; compare proper-context model to labels and null, no selection by null maximum.
metrics.benefit_gate: At least6 qualified cases with>=3PHerc0841. Mean AUC gain>=.10 versus current naive crop and>=.05 versus existing observed-normalization/zero-padding fix; nonnegative mean gain on each scroll. Every fidelity/nesting/full-tile identity gate must pass. No IID pixel p-values or worldwide priority/prize award inference.
metrics.secondary: All optional padding modes reported; no choosing the best post-hoc as the primary method.

admission: Materialize arrays/receipts, then score in a separate process without candidate imports. Old negative gates remain unchanged. A successful test is bounded to this new workflow and references.
submission: Prepare code, exact examples, source/competitor attribution, reproducible package and practical limitations. No external sending, publication, peer review or human attestation fabricated.
